Rules: Do not use cloud/cluster CLIs (kubectl, az, aws, snow, hcloud); ask the orchestrator to delegate to the matching specialist.

CliTools.Name: dotnet
CliTools.UseCase: .NET SDK. Use `--nologo -v q` for build/test/restore to keep output terse. Always pass `--nologo -v q`; if one command fails, rerun only that command with `-v n` and filter with rg.

CliTools.Name: npm
CliTools.UseCase: JavaScript packages. Example: `npm install`, `npm run <script>`. Install only after manifest changes or missing-dependency failures.

CliTools.Name: dotnet-script
CliTools.UseCase: Run existing C# .csx scripts. Example: `dotnet script file.csx`.
